subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A family installed a smart door lock that opened with a phone.”?
options: She later learned that his family had one old phone and no stable internet at home.
One day, the phone battery died while the family was outside.
The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school.
His family helped him set a password, but he forgot it the next day.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「She later learned that his family had one old phone and no stable internet at home.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「One day, the phone battery died while the family was outside.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「The no-homework side talked about rest, family time, and learning outside school.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「His family helped him set a password, but he forgot it the next day.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「One day, the phone battery died while the family was outside.」，答案為「One day, the phone battery died while the family was outside.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「One day, the phone battery died while the family was outside.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
